requirement: Find places reopens on the last results even when the page's storage refuses the whole answer: a lighter form (no checks, stats or scores, asked again after restore) is kept, and a refused write is reported instead of silently leaving only the place, which made every visit run a new paid search

oracle.invariant: 0 failures. A store that refuses the whole answer gets the lighter form, which still restores all places with their photos; a store that refuses even that reports `none` and remembers no search.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: the last search is kept whole when it fits; a store that refuses it gets the lighter form, which still restores
a store that refuses even the lighter form reports it and remembers no search
openingStep: last results first, then the remembered place, then locate; never over a search already on screen
